Sean / all — attaching a draft pricing sheet (pricing_sheet_sentinel_v1.xlsx) and a short summary to send to Amelia. Key commercial design we recommend: an Elastic Anchor + Consumption-Protection Band plus Quarterly Smoothing.

One-page commercial summary (to send):
- Elastic Anchor: customer selects an initial monthly anchor (example: 10M tokens/mo). Anchor protects baseline capacity and secures lower unit rates.
- Consumption-Protection Band: 70% — 130% of the anchor is considered the protected range. Usage inside the band is billed at the anchor-tier unit rate; no cash true-up inside the band.
- Quarterly smoothing and carry-forward: usage delta outside the band is aggregated quarterly. If net over the quarter > 10% of committed tokens, then a one-way invoice true-up applies for the excess tokens. If net under the quarter, credits carry forward for up to two quarters.
- Overage pricing: marginal step rates above the protected band: +12% (131–170%), +25% (171–250%), above 250% requires capacity review and negotiated short-term surge pricing.
- Rebaseline clause: sustained average > 130% over two consecutive quarters triggers recommended rebaseline and an automatic 60-day notice; rebaseline qualifies for a volume discount ladder.

Proposed token rates (illustrative):
- Anchor tier (0–10M tokens/mo): $0.0009 / token
- Mid tier (10M–50M tokens/mo): $0.00072 / token (20% off anchor)
- Enterprise tier (50M+ tokens/mo): $0.00060 / token (33% off anchor)

Pilot concession: 3-month pilot at anchor tier pricing with 50% credit applied to first invoice upon conversion to a committed 12-month plan.

I'll include example calculations in the pricing sheet and a CSV cost model (cost_model_calculator.csv). Legal redlines and invoicing cadence left to Karthik.

Marissa
Director, Commercial Strategy
Redwood Inference

Quick notes for the commercial deck:
- Invoicing: Monthly in arrears with a quarterly reconciliation for smoothing. Quarterly reconciliation will indicate either an invoice for net overage or a credit memo for net under-usage (credits redeemable for future consumption within next two quarters).
- True-up floor: we propose a 10% quarterly floor (matches Marissa's suggestion) to avoid micro-true-ups and simplify finance reconciliation.
- Payment terms: Net 30. Prepayment discounts: 10% for annual prepay, 18% for two-year prepay. Prepayments applied against monthly invoices and reflected as a deposit balance.
- Cancellation / wind-down: If customer terminates without cause mid-year, prepayment balance is prorated; termination for convenience carries a 60-day wind-down provision.
- Audit & usage reporting: we will provide token-level monthly usage exports and a signed monthly usage statement as an attachment to the invoice.

I also added a suggested DocuSign template for the commitment exhibit; sending the link to Sean for review.

Amelia — thanks for the clarification request. Please find a compact commercial response below and attached documents.

Compact commercial answer:
- Recommended construct: Elastic Anchor + Consumption-Protection Band + Quarterly Smoothing. Anchor secures preferred unit pricing and predictable capacity; the band and quarterly smoothing avoid frequent cash true-ups and align with seasonal variance.

How overages/underutilization are handled:
- Usage within 70–130% of anchor billed at anchor-tier rates.
- Quarterly reconciliation aggregates usage outside the band. Net over-usage beyond the 10% quarterly floor is invoiced at marginal overage rates (per the step ladder). Net under-usage becomes a credit that carries forward up to two quarters.

Discounts and prepay options:
- Pay-as-you-go: list rates (annex).
- 12-month prepay: 10% discount off listed anchor-tier pricing.
- 24-month prepay: 18% discount.
- Pilot offer: 3-month pilot at anchor-tier rates with 50% of pilot fees credited to first invoice upon conversion to a 12-month committed plan.

Example invoice walkthrough (illustrative):
- Anchor: 10M tokens/mo at $0.0009 = $9,000/mo baseline.
- Month A (seasonal spike): 16M tokens -> 6M over anchor; 6M falls into 131–170% band: billed at $0.0009*(1+12%) = $0.001008 for those marginal tokens => surcharge = $6,048. Quarterly smoothing aggregates and only invoices net above 10% quarterly floor.

Attachments included: rfp_response_summary.docx, pricing_sheet_sentinel_v1.xlsx, sentinel_sla_examples.pdf, cost_model_calculator.csv.

Next steps / ask:
1) Can you confirm target anchor sizing (we suggest using your 12-month rolling average)?
2) Does procurement want the 12- or 24-month prepay option priced formally?
3) Would you like a 30-minute call this week to walk the invoice example and pilot mechanics?

If those look good I can circulate a one-page exhibit that we can drop into the SOW + a DocuSign link for the commitment exhibit.
